backend: genuine Linux MD RAID1 on disposable guest-only /dev/vdb and /dev/vdc
preparation: mdadm --create /dev/md0 --metadata=1.2 --level=1 --raid-devices=2 --run /dev/vdb /dev/vdc; await kernel synchronization idle and degraded=0
raw_capture: Bounded ASCII sysfs MD attributes: level, raid_disks, degraded, array_state, sync_action; each present reviewed member state, slot, errors. No raw block contents.
independent_oracles: mdadm --detail --test exit0 plus /proc/mdstat [UU]; after member failure exit1 plus /proc/mdstat [U_] or [_U]
expected: Actual successful MCP typed projections; only collection timestamps removed. No synthesized health states.
scope: Reported non-atomic software RAID redundancy, not hardware RAID or physical-media assurance
